openers.text: Happy birthday, {name}!
Happiest of birthdays, {name}!
It is your day, {name}, and we are so glad to celebrate you.
Happy birthday!
Wishing you the happiest of birthdays!
Today we celebrate a truly wonderful person.

middles: You bring so much warmth and light to everyone around you, and the office is a better place because of you.
Your kindness is the quiet kind that holds everything together, and we notice it every single day.
Working with you makes the busy days lighter and the ordinary days brighter.
You lead with patience and heart, and all of us are grateful for it.
Your good humor and steady presence mean more to this team than you know.
Thank you for the care you put into everything you do and everyone you work with.
closers: We hope this year gives back all the kindness you share so freely.
May your year be filled with good health, good food, and the people you love most.
Here is to another year of laughter, good work, and small celebrations.
Enjoy every minute of your day. You have more than earned it.
We are cheering you on today and always.
shorts: Happy birthday! Your kindness keeps this whole office going.
Wishing you a day as warm as the welcome you give everyone.
Thank you for making this workplace feel like family. Happy birthday!
May your year be gentle, joyful, and full of good people.
Happy birthday to someone who makes every day brighter.
Your warmth is a gift to all of us. Enjoy your special day!
Here is to good health, good company, and a very happy birthday.
We are grateful for you today and every day. Happy birthday!
Wishing you laughter, rest, and everything you love most.
Happy birthday! The office is warmer because you are in it.
closings: Wishing you a year as warm and generous as you are.
May your year ahead be full of the same kindness you share with everyone.
Here is to a year of good health, good days, and people who love you.
May every day this year be as bright as you make ours.
Wishing you all the warmth and happiness you so freely give.
To another year of laughter, growth, and good company.

openers.text: Happy birthday, {name}, and thank you for everything.
On your birthday, {name}, we just want to say thank you.
Happiest birthday, {name}. Today is our turn to give back.
Today we celebrate you, with full and grateful hearts.
Happy birthday, and thank you for all that you do.
Some people make everything better just by being there, and today we say thank you to one of them.

middles: Your guidance, patience, and generosity have carried this team through more than you know.
Every deadline met and every problem solved has your steady hand behind it.
You give your time, your ideas, and your encouragement without ever asking for anything back.
The work is better, and the workplace is kinder, because of the way you show up every day.
Your support lifts the people around you, and your example sets the tone for all of us.
We have learned so much from working beside you, and we are thankful for every bit of it.
closers: May this year return to you even a portion of what you have given to us.
We hope you feel, today, how deeply appreciated you are.
Wishing you rest, joy, and a year as generous as you are.
Thank you, and happy birthday. We are lucky to have you.
Here is to you, with gratitude today and every day.
shorts: Thank you for leading with patience and heart. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday, and thank you for all the ways you lift this team.
Your hard work never goes unnoticed. Thank you, and happy birthday!
Grateful for your guidance today and always. Happy birthday!
Thank you for giving so much of yourself to this work. Enjoy your day!
Happy birthday to a colleague we truly appreciate.
Your dedication inspires us. Thank you, and happy birthday!
We owe you many thanks, and today we add one more: happy birthday!
Thank you for your kindness, your wisdom, and your steady hand.
Happy birthday! Working with you is something we are thankful for.
closings: With grateful hearts, we wish you a wonderful year ahead.
Thank you for everything, and may this year give back to you in kind.
May you receive this year even a portion of the good you have given.
Our thanks goes with you into a year that we hope is your best yet.
Wishing you a year filled with the appreciation you so richly deserve.
With gratitude today and always, happy birthday and best wishes.

openers.text: Happy birthday, {name}! The cake is officially on us.
It is {name} day, and we have been looking forward to it all week.
Breaking news, {name}: you are another year more awesome.
Happy birthday! Today, the only deadline is the cake.
Another year wiser, and somehow even more fun to work with.
Birthday mode: on. Work mode: see you tomorrow.

middles: You make meetings shorter, coffee breaks longer, and the whole office happier.
Your laugh should be part of the official office supplies, because we cannot get through the week without it.
You have a gift for turning stressful days into stories we laugh about later.
Between your ideas and your jokes, there is never a dull day when you are around.
You work hard, celebrate harder, and make sure nobody skips the snacks.
Seriously, the team group chat agrees: work would be far less fun without you.
closers: May your day be filled with cake, zero emails, and all your favorite people.
Wishing you a year of wins at work and naps on weekends.
Enjoy your day off from being the responsible one. We will hold the fort, probably.
Here is to more laughter, more cake, and fewer surprise meetings.
Have the happiest birthday. You deserve every slice.
shorts: Wishing you good health, good food, and zero paperwork today.
Happy birthday! Cake first, meetings never.
Another year of being the office favorite. Happy birthday!
May your inbox be empty and your plate be full. Happy birthday!
Happy birthday! You do not look a day over fabulous.
Today we celebrate you, preferably with cake.
Wishing you a birthday as fun as you make our workdays.
Happy birthday! Officially too cool for overtime today.
May your coffee be strong and your birthday cake stronger.
Cheers to you! Now, who is bringing the cake?
closings: May your year be full of cake, confetti, and conveniently short meetings.
Here is to a year of big wins, long weekends, and extra servings of cake.
Wishing you twelve months of fun, with meetings that could have been emails.
May your year sparkle, and may your snacks never go missing from the pantry.
To a year as fun as you are, and only slightly more chaotic.
Wishing you a year of laughter, leftovers, and leaving work on time.

openers.text: Warmest birthday greetings, {name}.
On behalf of the whole team, happy birthday, {name}.
It is our pleasure to greet you on your birthday, {name}.
Please accept our warmest greetings on your birthday.
We extend our heartfelt greetings on this special occasion.
Today, we honor a valued colleague on their birthday.

middles: Your professionalism, dedication, and integrity continue to inspire everyone in this office.
Your leadership and commitment to our shared work set a standard we all strive to meet.
We recognize and appreciate the excellence you bring to every responsibility entrusted to you.
Your contributions to our programs and to the people we serve are truly commendable.
It is a privilege to work alongside someone of your competence and character.
Your steady dedication strengthens our team and advances our mission every day.
closers: We wish you continued success, good health, and fulfillment in the year ahead.
May the coming year bring you well deserved rewards and new milestones.
Please accept our sincerest wishes for a meaningful and joyful celebration.
We look forward to another year of working with you. Happy birthday.
With our highest regard, we wish you a very happy birthday.
shorts: Warmest greetings on your birthday. We wish you continued success.
Happy birthday. Your dedication to our work is deeply appreciated.
Please accept our sincerest birthday wishes and highest regard.
Wishing you good health and fulfillment in the year ahead.
Happy birthday to a valued member of our team.
Your exemplary service is recognized and appreciated. Happy birthday.
We extend our heartfelt greetings on this special day.
May your birthday be as commendable as your work. Best wishes.
Happy birthday. It is an honor to work alongside you.
With gratitude for your service, we wish you a very happy birthday.
closings: We wish you continued success and good health in the year ahead.
May the year ahead bring you fulfillment in all your endeavors.
Please accept our best wishes for a prosperous and meaningful year.
We extend our warmest wishes for your continued success and well-being.
May this new year of your life be marked by achievement and good health.
With our sincerest regards, we wish you a distinguished year ahead.
